purpose: Decide policy-only episodic retrieval and prediction-integrated episodic retrieval separately, using a four-way ablation on untouched data.

prior_evidence_status.episodic-policy-live-choice-v5: consumed prior evidence only; its seeds and outcomes do not enter either decision below
prior_evidence_status.declared_expectation: On consumed v5 A-arm traces a runtime-faithful frozen replay regressed body MAE in 7 of 8 traces with vision tied. Condition C is therefore expected to fail. This expectation is stated in advance and does not alter any rule.

configuration_under_test.code: the commit that adds this file; no episodic, predictor, or policy change after it
configuration_under_test.prediction_retrieval: body-only median residual of same-action neighbours, as in v5
configuration_under_test.policy_retrieval: evidence-weighted local consensus, as in v5

world.fixture: integrations/luanti/ci/episodic_choice_ab (forward thrust depletes fullness, backward thrust returns it, applied by a test hook after the full action hold)

seed_provenance: none of these seeds appears in any earlier preregistration, harness, test, or run directory
controls: fresh reset world and newborn checkpoint per arm
same genome identity, runtime seed, map seed, starting pose, health 20 and hunger 10 within a seed
arms run sequentially in the fixed order A, B, C, D for every seed
action histories are allowed to diverge between arms; identical histories are not required

frozen_replay.recorded_transitions: the complete A-arm trace of each seed
frozen_replay.split: first 80 percent replayed with learning and memory writes in runtime order; final 20 percent scored with no learning and no memory writes
frozen_replay.metrics: pooled absolute error and MAE per modality (vision features 0-11, body 12-17); paired transition wins/ties/losses; held-item reported as a diagnostic only
frozen_replay.pooling: sum absolute errors and feature samples over all eight seeds, then divide

metrics: resource_returns and resource_losses over the 40 scored choices
per-pair return delta X minus A
deaths and minimum felt health from the trace (survival and injury)
mediation: episode writes, retrievals with body evidence, positive score deltas, selected-action changes, and one-step outcomes after each changed action
online one-step prediction MAE of each arm on its own trace (sim-luanti online-prediction), diagnostic only

policy_criterion(X): aggregate resource losses fall by at least 16 and aggregate resource returns rise by at least 16, X against A
at least 6 of 8 pairs have a positive return delta and no pair has a negative return delta

mediation in X: positive outcome writes > 0, retrievals with body evidence > 0, action changes > 0, and changed actions followed by a nonnegative one-step outcome are at least as many as those followed by a negative one
prediction_criterion(T, K): frozen replay, pooled over the eight seeds: body MAE of T <= body MAE of K and vision MAE of T <= vision MAE of K
at least one of body or vision is strictly lower for T, and in that modality pooled paired transition wins exceed losses

prediction_regression_tolerance.justification: No accepted reason exists to trade prediction accuracy for retrieval; prediction is the brain's learning signal and any accepted regression would compound in later graph and spatial work.

validity: fixture valid for every seed: the A arm has baseline exposure valid, observed fullness increases > 0 and decreases > 0, and every arm records 40 scored choices
all 32 live traces replay exactly through the runtime
frozen replay reports A = B and C = D exactly for every seed (the policy switch cannot alter prediction on fixed actions)
decision_rules.accept_policy_only_retrieval_B: validity holds AND policy_criterion(B) holds AND frozen B equals frozen A exactly (zero prediction regression)
decision_rules.accept_prediction_integrated_retrieval: validity holds AND prediction_criterion(C, A) holds AND policy_criterion(D) holds AND prediction_criterion(D, B) holds
decision_rules.independence: Each decision stands alone. B may be accepted when C or D fails; prediction retrieval then stays disabled.
decision_rules.no_composite: Modalities and behaviour are never combined into one score.

exclusions_and_stopping.runs: every one of the 32 arms is run exactly once; no early stopping and no additional seeds
exclusions_and_stopping.infrastructure_failure: if an arm's processes crash or time out before writing a result, that arm alone is rerun once with the same seed before any result is inspected; a second failure stops the experiment as incomplete with no conclusion
exclusions_and_stopping.integrity_failure: a replay mismatch or an invalid fixture is not rerun; the affected decisions fail validity
exclusions_and_stopping.after_outcomes: this file, the seeds, and the thresholds are not revised after any Experiment 003 outcome is generated; the seeds are consumed whatever the result
